identification: Victorian walnut (rosewood-toned) music cabinet, single glazed arched door, satinwood scroll inlay to top, brass three-sided gallery with turned finials, carved corbels, plinth base, about 90-100cm high. Unmarked, later glossy top finish. Typical brown-furniture music cabinet, not a named maker.

viewing_check: Check the top finish and any water marks, loose or missing gallery rods and finials, door glass and lock/key, veneer lifting or losses, whether inlay is original, and shelf condition. Photograph any label or stamp inside.
